text: Taking two torches. <break time="0.8s" /> I led Fortunato down. <break time="0.8s" /> A long and winding staircase. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the deep vaults. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the Montresor family. <break time="0.8s" /> The nitre. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking at the white webs. <break time="0.8s" /> That shone on the walls. <break time="0.8s" /> And then he began to cough. <break time="0.8s" /> Let us go back. <break time="0.8s" /> Because your health is precious. <break time="0.8s" /> And you are rich, respected, and loved. <break time="0.8s" /> Just as I once was I said. <break time="0.8s" /> The cough is nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> And it will not kill me. <break time="0.8s" /> He answered. <break time="0.8s" /> I shall not die of a cough. <break time="0.8s" /> True, true. <break time="0.8s" /> I replied. <break time="0.8s" /> And I gave him a bottle of fine wine. <break time="0.8s" /> From a long row. <break time="0.8s" /> Lying on the damp ground. <break time="0.8s" /> He lifted the bottle to his lips. <break time="0.8s" /> And said with a smile. <break time="0.8s" /> I drink to the dead. <break time="0.8s" /> Who lie around us. <break time="0.8s" /> And I drink to your long life. <break time="0.8s" /> I answered. <break time="0.8s" /> And we walked on deeper into the earth. <break time="0.8s" /> Our family arms show. <break time="0.8s" /> A golden foot crushing a snake. <break time="0.8s" /> And our motto means. <break time="0.8s" /> No one attacks me. <break time="0.8s" /> Without being punished. <break time="0.8s" /> Later when he asked. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether I was one of the masons. <break time="0.8s" /> A secret brotherhood. <break time="0.8s" /> I told him that I was. <break time="0.8s" /> Here is my sign. <break time="0.8s" /> I said. <break time="0.8s" /> And I pulled a small trowel. <break time="0.8s" /> From under my cloak. <break time="0.8s" /> But he only laughed at my joke.
